items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1961-06-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Dorsey's? Perdido and Dryas? ... [INTERVIEWER] Oh yes, yes, I remember him. Yes, I remember him.

ctx.x: You remember Dorsey's? Perdido and Dryas?
Oh yes, yes, I remember him. Yes, I remember him. Did they have bands there or anything? Yeah, they used to have entertainment there. On Perdido and Dryas, yeah.
